consentDialog.title: Consent for AI Personal Data Processing
consentDialog.intro: To provide intelligent job matching, CV analysis, and career insights, InterVue uses AI models to evaluate your profile and application data.
consentDialog.purposeMatching: Matching CV qualifications against job requirements and technical criteria
consentDialog.purposeSummaries: Generating objective skill summaries and suggested interview questions for recruiters
consentDialog.purposeSupport: Answering your inquiries via the AI Support Assistant
consentDialog.privacyGuarantees: Sensitive personal attributes (age, gender, photo, national ID) are strictly excluded from AI processing. AI assists recruiters; humans make all final hiring decisions.

resumeMatch.humanDecisionDisclaimer: AI evaluation is advisory only. Missing information is not missing skill. Final hiring decisions rest entirely with recruiters.
